title: And I Was Not Aware
question: How often is God present somewhere before anyone notices?
blurb: Jacob wakes up on a stone pillow. Four verses about ground that turns out to be holy.

nodes.content: How often is God present somewhere before anyone notices?

nodes.verseText: When Jacob woke up, he said, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I was unaware of it.”
And Jacob had a dream about a ladder that rested on the earth with its top reaching up to heaven, and God’s angels were going up and down the ladder.
Then He declared, “Truly, truly, I tell you, you will all see heaven open and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
“Do not come any closer,” God said. “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground.”
Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence? If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
